# Core-CNC

> Core-CNC is an independent CNC advisory business based in the Midlands, UK, helping manufacturing companies improve their CNC practices, tooling choices, and equipment decisions.

Core-CNC works with manufacturing businesses across the Midlands, bringing hands-on, shop-floor experience rather than theoretical consulting. The advisory has no ties to any tooling or equipment supplier, so recommendations are based on what's right for the client.

## Services

- CNC Practices & Process Review: an honest look at how a CNC operation runs today, and where efficiency, consistency and part quality can be improved without a full overhaul.
- Tooling Selection & Optimisation: independent guidance on cutting tools and tooling strategy, matched to a client's materials, machines and production goals.
- Equipment Advisory: impartial advice before committing to new machine tools or equipment, so the investment fits how the shop actually works.
